customCss.title: Custom CSS
customCss.loadOnly: Select to load. Apply to use.

customCss.deletePrompt: Delete this saved copy? Applied CSS and editor text are kept:
customCss.name: Name
customCss.registerHelp: Save a named copy to the list. This does not apply it to chat.
customCss.applied: CSS enabled. Check its appearance in chat.
customCss.saveFailed: Save unconfirmed. Text is kept. Review the current state before retrying.
customCss.invalid: Enter a name and CSS in the supported format.
customCss.tooLarge: CSS must fit within 64 KiB and the serialized-data limit. Shorten the CSS. Your text has not been truncated.
customCss.libraryFull: Up to 20 copies can be saved. Delete an unused copy.
customCss.duplicateName: That name is taken. Choose another name.
customCss.conflict: Saved CSS changed since editing started. Continuing replaces that setting. You can cancel and load the saved text instead.
customCss.discardOnClose: Discard unapplied CSS or the unsaved registration name and close? Applied and registered CSS will remain.
customCss.appearanceFull: Appearance presets exceed the backup budget. Remove an unused preset; the attempted change was not committed.
customCss.exportFailed: The settings backup could not be created. Reduce the saved CSS or presets and try again.
customCss.recoveryFailed: The pause/resume request could not be confirmed. Chat tabs may still use the previous setting. Retry or disable the extension before reloading.
customCss.libraryTooLarge: Saved CSS exceeds the total limit. Delete an unused copy.
customCss.busy: Another CSS change is being saved. Your text is still here.
customCss.savingStop: Saving pause. It is not confirmed yet.
customCss.closeWhileSaving: The save result is not confirmed. Closing discards editor drafts, but an in-flight save can still complete. Stay here to see the result.
customCss.presetHelp: Start with an included preset. They do not hide names, badges or the message composer.
customCss.presetBubblesDescription: Give regular messages a subtle background and rounded corners. Keep your current text color and size.
customCss.presetCardsDescription: Separate comments with a fine border and a subtle shadow. Keep author and message colors unchanged.
customCss.presetOutlineDescription: Use white regular-message text with a dark shadow to emphasize its outline. Leave names, badges and link colors unchanged.
customCss.presetOutlineNote: This CSS does not make the panel transparent. Adjust the existing Background color opacity separately to see the video behind it.
customCss.presetCompactDescription: Reduce vertical spacing while keeping names, avatars and wrapping for long messages.
customCss.presetComfortableDescription: Use at least 16px text with more line spacing and vertical room. Preserve a larger size selected in the existing settings.
customCss.presetAccentDescription: Add a blue stripe to each regular message. Edit --ylc-preset-accent in the CSS to change the stripe color.
customCss.failedApplyHelp: Choose Disable to cancel retrying the failed apply. Your text is kept.
customCss.savedEmptyHelp: Choose Save to keep a copy.
customCss.savedHelp: Edits and Apply do not overwrite this copy. Save with a new name to keep your changes.
customCss.savedMissing: This registration was removed. Your editor text is still here.
customCss.emptyEditor: Paste CSS, or choose a starter preset.
customCss.savedButPaused: Matches saved CSS. The all-CSS pause remains on.
customCss.savedButDisabled: Saved text is retained, but its effect is disabled.
customCss.externalChange: CSS changed in another view. Your text is kept.
customCss.pausePendingState: Matches saved CSS. Whether all CSS is paused is still unconfirmed.
